concerns.text: The spec's sole input is 'public Reddit comment datasets from Pushshift' (US-1, FR-011, Assumption 1), but no verified Reddit/Pushshift dataset exists in this round. The plan correctly refuses to fabricate a source and installs a Data Availability Gate, but the underlying spec requirement is unsatisfiable as written — the spec needs a verified, reachable Reddit dataset (or a revised data-source story) before FR-011/FR-013/SC-001 can be met with real data. Root cause is in the spec, not the plan.

FR-017 requires demographic proxies 'extracted from user profile metadata (e.g., Reddit "about" fields)'. Plan Task 9 says 'Demographic proxies (age/gender keyword patterns) from user text' — comment text, not profile metadata. The ingestion design (Task 2) drops author fields and aggregates comments only, so profile metadata is never ingested. Either the plan must ingest profile metadata or the spec's FR-017 wording must be revised to match the comment-text proxy; as written the plan does not implement FR-017's stated source.
